DOWNFALL-BLACK_POWDER.title: Black Powder
DOWNFALL-BLACK_POWDER.description: Whenever you trigger a [gold]Dead On[/gold] effect, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
DOWNFALL-BLOODY_TOOTH.title: Broken Tooth
DOWNFALL-BLOODY_TOOTH.description: Whenever you defeat an Elite encounter, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP and gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] Gold.
DOWNFALL-BLOODY_TOOTH.flavor: Appears too large to have come from a human jaw...
DOWNFALL-BRASS_TACKS.title: Brass Tacks
DOWNFALL-BRASS_TACKS.description: At the end of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
DOWNFALL-BRASS_TACKS.flavor: The luster on these tacks never seems to fade.
DOWNFALL-CHARRED_GLOVE.title: Charred Glove
DOWNFALL-CHARRED_GLOVE.flavor: Parts of the glove still glow with otherworldly cinders.
DOWNFALL-CLASPED_LOCKET.title: Clasped Locket
DOWNFALL-CLASPED_LOCKET.description: Replaces [gold]Old Locket[/gold]. The first time you draw a [gold]Curse[/gold] each turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards. Upon pickup, add [blue]{Injuries}[/blue] [gold]Injuries[/gold] to your deck.
DOWNFALL-HORSESHOE.title: Horseshoe
DOWNFALL-HORSESHOE.description: Whenever you would gain [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Frail[/gold], or [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] less.
DOWNFALL-HORSESHOE.flavor: Lucky charm. Somebody is gonna be missing this.
DOWNFALL-OLD_LOCKET.title: Old Locket
DOWNFALL-OLD_LOCKET.description: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Memento[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-PET_GHOST.title: Pet Ghost
DOWNFALL-PET_GHOST.description: Prevent your first lethal HP loss each combat.
DOWNFALL-RED_SCARF.title: Red Scarf
DOWNFALL-RED_SCARF.description: Whenever you apply a new Debuff to an enemy, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
DOWNFALL-RIPPED_DOLL.title: Ripped Doll
DOWNFALL-RIPPED_DOLL.description: At the start of the first [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns of combat, [gold]Conjure[/gold].
DOWNFALL-RIPPED_DOLL.flavor: The last reminder of your prior self. It still holds latent magicks.
DOWNFALL-RYE_STALK.title: Rye Stalk
DOWNFALL-RYE_STALK.description: Whenever you lose HP during the enemy's turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card.
DOWNFALL-RYE_STALK.flavor: Still in mint condition, despite being chewed on for so long.
DOWNFALL-SPYGLASS.title: Spyglass
DOWNFALL-SPYGLASS.description: If you end your turn [gold]Concentrated[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
DOWNFALL-STRAIGHT_RAZOR.title: Straight Razor
DOWNFALL-STRAIGHT_RAZOR.description: Whenever you remove or [gold]Transform[/gold] a card from your deck, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
DOWNFALL-CAWING_CASK.title: Cawing Cask
DOWNFALL-CAWING_CASK.description: Whenever you use a potion, gain [blue]{RitualPower}[/blue] [gold]Ritual[/gold].
DOWNFALL-CAWING_CASK.flavor: A ceremonially carved barrel depicting the crow god Mazaleth, its contents smell questionable...
DOWNFALL-CURSED_BLESSING.title: Final Rites
DOWNFALL-CURSED_BLESSING.description: The first time you activate [blue]{Chants}[/blue] [gold]Chant[/gold] effects in a combat, gain [blue]{RitualPower}[/blue] [gold]Ritual[/gold].
DOWNFALL-CURSED_BLESSING.flavor: I leave everything I own to my cat, Noodles. Goodbye, cruel world. XOXO Jouster
DOWNFALL-CURVED_SWORD.title: Zetsumei
DOWNFALL-CURVED_SWORD.description: Every time you play [blue]{Spells}[/blue] Spells in a combat, add a [gold]Ceremony[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-CURVED_SWORD.flavor: A blade favored by mages due to its ability to channel casted magic back into itself.
DOWNFALL-DEAD_BIRD.title: Corvid Spirit
DOWNFALL-DEAD_BIRD.description: At the end of your turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to the lowest HP enemy, increased by [gold]Strength[/gold].
DOWNFALL-DEAD_BIRD.flavor: This spectre closely follows behind the damned and cursed.
DOWNFALL-EYE_OF_THE_OCCULT.title: Eye of the Occult
DOWNFALL-EYE_OF_THE_OCCULT.flavor: This gruesome carving imparts magical knowledge to its owner.
DOWNFALL-HEXX_BOMB.title: Manabomb
DOWNFALL-HEXX_BOMB.description: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer any [gold]Manaburn[/gold] it has to a random enemy.
DOWNFALL-MINI_BLACK_HOLE.title: Alethea
DOWNFALL-MINI_BLACK_HOLE.description: If you do not play any [gold]Powers[/gold] during your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional card next turn.
DOWNFALL-MOON_TALISMAN.title: Crescent Talisman
DOWNFALL-MOON_TALISMAN.description: Upon pickup, choose a card that does [red]NOT[/red] have [gold]Conjure[/gold], and add [gold]Conjure[/gold] to it.
DOWNFALL-MOON_TALISMAN.flavor: "Please, just... don't forget me. Even after I die."
DOWNFALL-MOON_TALISMAN.selectionScreenPr: Choose a card to bless with Conjure.
DOWNFALL-SHARD_OF_NOWAK.title: Gilded Bone Shard
DOWNFALL-SHARD_OF_NOWAK.description: Start each combat with [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. After losing any type of HP, lose that [gold]Strength[/gold] for the rest of combat.
DOWNFALL-SHREDDED_DOLL.title: Shredded Doll
DOWNFALL-SHREDDED_DOLL.description: Replaces [gold]Ripped Doll[/gold]. At the start of your turn, [gold]Conjure[/gold]. The first time you refresh your Spells each combat, gain [blue]{RitualPower}[/blue] [gold]Ritual[/gold].
DOWNFALL-SHREDDED_DOLL.flavor: A reminder of your weakness, and yet you still can't let go.
DOWNFALL-STRENGTH_BOOSTER.title: Paper Crow
DOWNFALL-STRENGTH_BOOSTER.flavor: Arbiter of doubt and curses folded one thousand times...
DOWNFALL-TOME_OF_PORTALMANCY.title: Tome of Portalmancy
DOWNFALL-TOME_OF_PORTALMANCY.description: Whenever you create a [gold]Void[/gold], apply [blue]{ManaburnPower}[/blue] [gold]Manaburn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
DOWNFALL-TOME_OF_PORTALMANCY.flavor: A grimoire detailing the construction and maintenance of interplanar gates.
DOWNFALL-VIOLET_PLUMAGE.title: Violet Plumage
DOWNFALL-VIOLET_PLUMAGE.description: The first time you end your turn with excess [gold]Energy[/gold] each combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional cards at the start of your next turn.
DOWNFALL-VIOLET_PLUMAGE.flavor: Tinged by the unending darkness of oblivion.
DOWNFALL-ZENER_DECK.title: Zener Deck
DOWNFALL-ZENER_DECK.description: At the start of combat, add [gold]ESP[/gold] to your Spellbook and [gold]Conjure[/gold] it.
DOWNFALL-ZENER_DECK.flavor: "One, two, three, all eyes should be on me."
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_KNOB.title: Mob Leader's Staff
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_KNOB.description: At the start of each combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card, and [gold]Swap[/gold] to the next Gremlin.
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_KNOB.additionalRestSite: Also heals standby Gremlins and revives a fallen Gremlin at [blue]50%[/blue] HP.
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_KNOB.flavor: Among gremlin mobs, the one with the best horn maintains complete command over the troupe, until another one manages to steal it.
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_MOB_STATUS.title: Gremlin Mob HP
DOWNFALL-FRAGMENTATION_GRENADE.title: Fragmentation Grenade
DOWNFALL-FRAGMENTATION_GRENADE.descripti: Damage dealt to random enemies is increased by [blue]{Damage}[/blue].
DOWNFALL-FRAGMENTATION_GRENADE.flavor: Nobody dares to ask where the Gremlin got it from.
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_BOMB.title: Gremlin Bomb
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_BOMB.description: The first time your HP drops to [blue]50%[/blue] or below each combat, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_BOMB.flavor: Gremlins have an uncanny knack for finding dangerous things. Sometimes, they even survive looting them.
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_GRAVESTONE.title: Gremlin Gravestone
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_GRAVESTONE.description: Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], revive a fallen Gremlin at full HP. If all Gremlins are alive, heal ALL Gremlins by [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_GRAVESTONE.flavor: Where do gremlins go when they die? Not bloody far enough.
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_KNOB_UPGRADE.title: Mob Leader's Crown
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_KNOB_UPGRADE.descriptio:
Replaces [gold]Mob Leader's Staff[/gold].
The first time you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card, and [gold]Swap[/gold] to the next Gremlin.
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_KNOB_UPGRADE.additional: Also heals standby Gremlins and revives a fallen Gremlin at [blue]50%[/blue] HP.
DOWNFALL-GREMLIN_KNOB_UPGRADE.flavor: The fancier the symbol of office, the more likely it is to be stolen.
DOWNFALL-IMPECCABLE_PECS.title: Impeccable Pecs
DOWNFALL-IMPECCABLE_PECS.description:
Whenever you gain [gold]Strength[/gold], gain an equal amount of [gold]Temp HP[/gold].
Start each combat with [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
DOWNFALL-MAGICAL_MALLET.title: Magic Mallet
DOWNFALL-MAGICAL_MALLET.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Weak[/gold] to an enemy, gain [blue]{WizPower}[/blue] [gold]Wiz[/gold], up to [blue]{MaxPerTurn}[/blue] times per turn.
DOWNFALL-PRICKLY_SHIELDS.title: Prickly Shields
DOWNFALL-PRICKLY_SHIELDS.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
DOWNFALL-PRICKLY_SHIELDS.flavor: Gremlins use whatever scraps they can find as weapons or armor. Some serve as both.
DOWNFALL-STOLEN_MERCHANDISE.title: Stolen Merchandise
DOWNFALL-STOLEN_MERCHANDISE.description: Whenever you [gold]Swap[/gold], add an [gold]Echo[/gold] of a random Colorless card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-SUPPLY_SCROLL.title: Supply Scroll
DOWNFALL-SUPPLY_SCROLL.description: At the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
DOWNFALL-SUPPLY_SCROLL.flavor: A surprisingly detailed inventory of the mob's various bits and bobbles.
DOWNFALL-TAG_TEAMWORK.title: Tag Teamwork
DOWNFALL-TAG_TEAMWORK.description:
Whenever you draw [gold]Tag Team[/gold], draw another card.
Upon pickup, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] copies of [gold]Tag Team[/gold] to your deck.
DOWNFALL-WIZARD_HAT.title: Wizard Hat
DOWNFALL-WIZARD_HAT.description: Whenever you consume [gold]Wiz[/gold], remove a random debuff from yourself.
DOWNFALL-WIZARD_HAT.flavor: The accompanying robes have long since been stolen.
DOWNFALL-WIZARD_STAFF.title: Wizard Staff
DOWNFALL-WIZARD_STAFF.flavor: The pride and joy of every Gremlin Wizard, this staff is a frequent target of theft by rival mobs.
DOWNFALL-WOUND_POKER.title: Wound Poker
DOWNFALL-WOUND_POKER.description: At the end of your turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to each [gold]Weak[/gold] enemy.
DOWNFALL-WOUND_POKER.flavor: Does it hurt when I do this?
DOWNFALL-CHAMPION_CROWN.title: Champion's Crown
DOWNFALL-CHAMPION_CROWN.description: At the start of combat, add [gold]Inspiration[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-CHAMPION_CROWN.flavor: To the victor go the spoils.
DOWNFALL-BARBELLS.title: Barbell
DOWNFALL-BARBELLS.description: Whenever you enter a Rest Site, if you have at least [blue]10[/blue] Upgradable cards in your deck, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] one at random.
DOWNFALL-BERSERKERS_GUIDE_TO_SLAUGHTER.d: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{VigorPower}[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold].
DOWNFALL-BLACK_KNIGHTS_HELMET.title: Black Knight's Helm
DOWNFALL-BLACK_KNIGHTS_HELMET.descriptio:
The first time you enter each [gold]Stance[/gold] each combat:
[gold]Defensive[/gold]: Gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
[gold]Berserker[/gold]: Gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
DOWNFALL-CHAMP_STANCES_MOD_RELIC.title: New Challenger
DOWNFALL-CHAMP_STANCES_MOD_RELIC.descrip: Start each combat in a random Champ [gold]Stance[/gold].
DOWNFALL-CHAMPION_CROWN_UPGRADED.title: Victorious Crown
DOWNFALL-CHAMPION_CROWN_UPGRADED.descrip:
Replaces [gold]Champion's Crown[/gold].
The first time you play a [gold]Finisher[/gold] each turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards and enter a random [gold]Stance[/gold].
DOWNFALL-CHAMPION_CROWN_UPGRADED.flavor: Conglaturation!! You are the greatest winner.
DOWNFALL-DEFENSIVE_TRAINING_MANUAL.title: Defensive Thesis
DOWNFALL-DEFLECTING_BRACERS.title: Deflecting Bracers
DOWNFALL-DEFLECTING_BRACERS.description: At the start of your turn, gain [gold]Counter[/gold] equal to half the amount of expired [gold]Block[/gold].
DOWNFALL-DEFLECTING_BRACERS.flavor: If you thought blocking was good then...
DOWNFALL-DUELING_GLOVE.title: Dueling Glove
DOWNFALL-DUELING_GLOVE.description: After playing a single-target Attack, if the target has no [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
DOWNFALL-FIGHTING_FOR_DUMMIES.title: Dolphin's Style Guide
DOWNFALL-FIGHTING_FOR_DUMMIES.descriptio: If you end your turn in no [gold]Stance[/gold], draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card next turn.
DOWNFALL-FIGHTING_FOR_DUMMIES.flavor: Author: Renowned explorer and pugilist Dolphin K. Mist.
DOWNFALL-GLADIATORS_BOOK_OF_MARTIAL_PROW: Whenever you play a [gold]Combo[/gold], play a [gold]Finisher[/gold], and enter a [gold]Stance[/gold] in the same turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
DOWNFALL-LIFT_RELIC.title: Inner Strength
DOWNFALL-LIFT_RELIC.flavor: It's about the gigantic sword in your heart.
DOWNFALL-SIGNATURE_FINISHER.title: Signature Finisher
DOWNFALL-SIGNATURE_FINISHER.description: Upon pickup, choose a [gold]Finisher[/gold]. It costs [blue]0[/blue], can be played without a [gold]Stance[/gold], and never exits your [gold]Stance[/gold].
DOWNFALL-SIGNATURE_FINISHER.flavor: And now, it's time for my ULTIMATE MOVE!
DOWNFALL-SIGNATURE_FINISHER.selectionScr: Choose a Finisher for Signature Finisher.
DOWNFALL-SPECTERS_HAND.title: Spectre's Hand
DOWNFALL-SPECTERS_HAND.description: Whenever you enter a [gold]Stance[/gold], add a [blue]0[/blue]-cost [gold]Strike[/gold] or [gold]Defend[/gold] [gold]Echo[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-SNECKO_SOUL.title: Snecko Soul
DOWNFALL-SNECKO_SOUL.description: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Soul Roll[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-SUPER_SNECKO_SOUL.title: Super Snecko Soul
DOWNFALL-SUPER_SNECKO_SOUL.description:
Replaces [gold]Snecko Soul[/gold].
At the start of each combat and every other turn, add a [gold]Soul Roll[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
On other turns, draw [blue]1[/blue] card and [gold]Muddle[/gold] it.
DOWNFALL-LOADED_DIE.title: Loaded Die
DOWNFALL-SEAL_OF_APPROVAL.title: Seal of Approval
DOWNFALL-SEAL_OF_APPROVAL.description: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Uncommon [gold]Offclass[/gold] Powers to add to your deck.
DOWNFALL-SEAL_OF_APPROVAL.flavor: I'm The Ironclad and this is my favorite Relic in the Spire.  -Merchant Advertising Pamphlet
DOWNFALL-SEAL_OF_APPROVAL.selectionScree: Choose an Uncommon Offclass Power to add to your deck.
DOWNFALL-BLANK_CARD.title: Blank Card
DOWNFALL-BLANK_CARD.description: At the start of each combat, add an [gold]Echo[/gold] of a random non-Curse, non-Status card from your deck to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs [blue]0[/blue] until played.
DOWNFALL-SLEEVED_ACE.title: Sleeved Ace
DOWNFALL-SLEEVED_ACE.description: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Marked Card+[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-CONFUSING_CODEX.title: Ring of the Snek
DOWNFALL-CONFUSING_CODEX.description: Whenever you activate [blue]{Threshold}[/blue] [gold]Overflow[/gold] effects, apply [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] and [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to a random enemy.
DOWNFALL-UNKNOWN_EGG.title: Unidentified Egg
DOWNFALL-UNKNOWN_EGG.description: Whenever you add an [gold]Offclass[/gold] card to your deck, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it. Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random [gold]Offclass[/gold] cards in your deck.
DOWNFALL-UNKNOWN_EGG.flavor: What will hatch? Pay $1000 to see.
DOWNFALL-RARE_BOOSTER_PACK.title: Rare Booster Box
DOWNFALL-RARE_BOOSTER_PACK.description: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Rare [gold]Offclass[/gold] cards to add to your deck.
DOWNFALL-ABSORB_END_COMBAT.title: Heart of Goo
DOWNFALL-ABSORB_END_COMBAT.description: Whenever you [gold]Consume[/gold] [gold]Goop[/gold], heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP (up to [blue]{Cap}[/blue] HP per combat).
DOWNFALL-ABSORB_END_COMBAT_UPGRADED.desc:
Replaces [gold]Heart of Goo[/gold].
Whenever you [gold]Consume[/gold] [gold]Goop[/gold], heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP (up to [blue]{Cap}[/blue] HP per combat).
DOWNFALL-ABSORB_END_COMBAT_UPGRADED.flav: Even richer in dark gelatinous nutrients.
DOWNFALL-AGGRESSIVE_SLIME_RELIC.title: Goop Dweller
DOWNFALL-AGGRESSIVE_SLIME_RELIC.descript: At the start of each combat, [gold]Split[/gold] a [gold]Bruiser Slime[/gold].
DOWNFALL-AGGRESSIVE_SLIME_RELIC.flavor: He followed me home. Can I keep it?
DOWNFALL-POTENCY_RELIC.title: Stone of Nomakk
DOWNFALL-POTENCY_RELIC.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{PotencyPower}[/blue] [gold]Potency[/gold].
DOWNFALL-POTENCY_RELIC.flavor: When presented to one of your Goop Gang, it seems to make the blob dance.
DOWNFALL-SLIMED_SKULL_RELIC.title: Slimy Skull
DOWNFALL-SLIMED_SKULL_RELIC.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Goop[/gold], apply an additional [blue]{AcidTonguePower}[/blue] [gold]Goop[/gold].
DOWNFALL-SLIMED_SKULL_RELIC.flavor: A Snecko skull in absolutely awful condition. Unclean and slimy, dirt and grime stick to it like glue.
DOWNFALL-MAX_SLIMES_RELIC.title: Jeremiah's Banner
DOWNFALL-MAX_SLIMES_RELIC.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Slots}[/blue] Slime slot and [gold]Split[/gold] a random Slime.
DOWNFALL-PREPARED_RELIC.title: Slime Soup
DOWNFALL-PREPARED_RELIC.description: Whenever you enter a Rest Site, begin the next combat with a [gold]Prepare[/gold] card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] that costs [blue]0[/blue] this turn.
DOWNFALL-STICKY_STICK.title: Gelatinous Cube
DOWNFALL-STICKY_STICK.description: Whenever you draw a [gold]Status[/gold] or [red]Curse[/red], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
DOWNFALL-STICKY_STICK.flavor: Hey, it stuck to your body.
DOWNFALL-SLIMED_TAIL_RELIC.title: Slimed Tail
DOWNFALL-SLIMED_TAIL_RELIC.flavor: A fake tail to trick enemies during combat, completely covered in slime.
DOWNFALL-SELF_DAMAGE_PREVENT_RELIC.title: Protective Gear
DOWNFALL-SELF_DAMAGE_PREVENT_RELIC.descr: Reduce the self-damage you take from "Tackle" cards by [blue]{Reduction}[/blue].
DOWNFALL-SELF_DAMAGE_PREVENT_RELIC.flavo: The best defense is a good offense.
DOWNFALL-MODE_SHIFTER.title: Bronze Gear
DOWNFALL-MODE_SHIFTER.description: Start each combat with [blue]20[/blue] [gold]Mode Shift[/gold] and add a [gold]Gear Up[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Begin your run with a random Common [gold]Gem[/gold] and socket [gold]Gems[/gold] at Rest Sites.
DOWNFALL-MODE_SHIFTER.flavor: A finely crafted bronze mechanism humming with ancient power.
DOWNFALL-MODE_SHIFTER_PLUS.title: Guardian's Gear
DOWNFALL-MODE_SHIFTER_PLUS.description:
Replaces [gold]Bronze Gear[/gold].
Start each combat with [blue]20[/blue] [gold]Mode Shift[/gold] and add a [gold]Gear Up[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Whenever [gold]Mode Shift[/gold] activates, gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy (or next turn) and draw [blue]2[/blue] cards.
DOWNFALL-MODE_SHIFTER_PLUS.flavor: Reinforced with crystalline bearings for instantaneous mode shifts.
DOWNFALL-DEFENSIVE_MODE_MORE_BLOCK.title: Baalor's Lordly Plate
DOWNFALL-DEFENSIVE_MODE_MORE_BLOCK.flavo: Forged to withstand the fiercest assaults of the Spire.
DOWNFALL-PICK_AXE.title: Pick of Rhapsody
DOWNFALL-PICK_AXE.description: Whenever you defeat an Elite encounter, add a random [gold]Gem[/gold] to the rewards.
DOWNFALL-PICK_AXE.flavor: A dependable mining pick tuned to crystalline veins.
DOWNFALL-BOTTLED_STASIS.title: Bottled Black Hole
DOWNFALL-BOTTLED_STASIS.description: Upon pickup, choose a card. Start each combat with this card in [gold]Stasis[/gold].
DOWNFALL-BOTTLED_STASIS.flavor: A miniature singularity suspended in tempered glass.
DOWNFALL-BOTTLED_STASIS.selectionScreenP: Choose a card for Bottled Black Hole.
DOWNFALL-POCKET_SENTRY.title: Arumba's Pocket Sentry
DOWNFALL-POCKET_SENTRY.description: Every [blue]3[/blue] turns, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
DOWNFALL-GEMSTONE_GUN.title: Gemstone Gun
DOWNFALL-GEMSTONE_GUN.description: Upon pickup, choose [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Gems[/gold]. At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Gemstone Gun[/gold] with those [gold]Gems[/gold] socketed to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-STASIS_UPGRADE_RELIC.title: Cryo Chamber
DOWNFALL-STASIS_UPGRADE_RELIC.descriptio: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Stasis[/gold] slot. Whenever a card enters [gold]Stasis[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
DOWNFALL-STASIS_UPGRADE_RELIC.flavor: Sub-zero preservation refines every blueprint placed inside.
DOWNFALL-BOTTLED_ANOMALY.title: Bottled Anomaly
DOWNFALL-BOTTLED_ANOMALY.description: Upon pickup, choose a card. At the start of each combat, remove it from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. At the start of turn [blue]3[/blue], add it to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs [blue]0[/blue] for the turn.
DOWNFALL-BOTTLED_ANOMALY.flavor: Time bends politely around whatever is sealed within.
DOWNFALL-BOTTLED_ANOMALY.selectionScreen: Choose a card for Bottled Anomaly.
DOWNFALL-SACK_OF_GEMS.title: Sack of Gems
DOWNFALL-SACK_OF_GEMS.description: Upon pickup, you may choose up to [blue]5[/blue] random [gold]Gems[/gold] to add to your deck.
DOWNFALL-SACK_OF_GEMS.flavor: Rattles like a fistful of glittering possibilities.
DOWNFALL-SACK_OF_GEMS.selectionScreenPro: Choose up to 5 Gems to add to your deck.
DOWNFALL-STASIS_CODEX.title: Pilot's Codex
DOWNFALL-STASIS_CODEX.description: At the end of your first [blue]3[/blue] turns, if your [gold]Stasis[/gold] slots aren't full, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] cards to place into [gold]Stasis[/gold].
DOWNFALL-STASIS_CODEX.flavor: Standard operating schematics for deep-Spire guardians.
SEA_GLASS.DOWNFALL-THE_HERMIT.title: Sea Glass (Hermit)
SEA_GLASS.DOWNFALL-THE_GREMLINS.title: Sea Glass (Gremlins)
SEA_GLASS.DOWNFALL-THE_CHAMP.title: Sea Glass (Champ)
SEA_GLASS.DOWNFALL-THE_SNECKO.title: Sea Glass (Snecko)
SEA_GLASS.DOWNFALL-THE_SLIME_BOSS.title: Sea Glass (Slime Boss)

SEA_GLASS.DOWNFALL-THE_HEXAGHOST.title: Sea Glass (Hexaghost)
DOWNFALL-SPIRIT_BRAND.title: Spirit Brand
DOWNFALL-SPIRIT_BRAND.description: The first time you [gold]Ignite[/gold] a Ghostflame each turn, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
DOWNFALL-UNBROKEN_SOUL.title: Mark of the Ether
DOWNFALL-UNBROKEN_SOUL.description:
Replaces [gold]Spirit Brand[/gold].
Whenever you [gold]Ignite[/gold] a Ghostflame, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
DOWNFALL-UNBROKEN_SOUL.flavor: Let's see if we can do... better.
DOWNFALL-BOLSTER_ENGINE.title: Tricky's Bolster-Rod
DOWNFALL-BOLSTER_ENGINE.description: The first time you play a [gold]Power[/gold] each combat, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
DOWNFALL-BOLSTER_ENGINE.flavor: Backed by the study of a thousand books. Knowledge is power!
DOWNFALL-INFLAMMATORY_LETTER.title: Jar of TOBSCo
DOWNFALL-INFLAMMATORY_LETTER.flavor: A little extra heat makes everything better.
DOWNFALL-JAR_OF_FUEL.title: Olexa's Shield
DOWNFALL-JAR_OF_FUEL.description: [gold]Powers[/gold] are counted towards the progression of [gold]Searing[/gold] and [gold]Crushing[/gold] [gold]Ghostflames[/gold].
DOWNFALL-RECYCLING_MACHINE.title: Recycler
DOWNFALL-RECYCLING_MACHINE.description: The first time a non-Status, non-Curse [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold] each combat, add a copy to your [gold]Hand[/gold] that costs [blue]0[/blue] until played.
DOWNFALL-RECYCLING_MACHINE.flavor: One day, it shall be recycled too.
DOWNFALL-CANDLE_OF_CAUTERIZING.title: Red Candle
DOWNFALL-MATCHSTICK_CASE.title: Sneaky Teakwood Match
DOWNFALL-MATCHSTICK_CASE.description: The first time you [gold]Ignite[/gold] each turn, you can choose whether to [gold]Advance[/gold] or [gold]Retract[/gold].
DOWNFALL-SIXITUDE.title: Six-Point Brand
DOWNFALL-SIXITUDE.description: Whenever you play [blue]{Count}[/blue] non-0-cost cards, gain an [gold]Echo[/gold] of a basic [gold]Strike[/gold]. It costs [blue]0[/blue].
DOWNFALL-SIXITUDE.flavor: Fire, fire, fire, fire, fire, FIRE!
DOWNFALL-SOUL_CONSUMER.title: Soul Stone
DOWNFALL-SOUL_CONSUMER.description: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [blue]{Count}[/blue] cards, [gold]Ignite[/gold] the current Ghostflame.
DOWNFALL-SOUL_CONSUMER.flavor: A soul would liven this thing up!
DOWNFALL-SOUL_OF_CHAOS.title: Soul of Chaos
DOWNFALL-SOUL_OF_CHAOS.description: At the start of your turn, move to a random Ghostflame and randomize it. At the end of your turn, play the top card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SEA_GLASS.DOWNFALL-THE_AUTOMATON.title: Sea Glass (Automaton)
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_CORE.title: Bronze Core
DOWNFALL-BRONZE_CORE.description: The first time you create a [gold]Function[/gold] each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy.
DOWNFALL-PLATINUM_CORE.title: Platinum Core
DOWNFALL-PLATINUM_CORE.description:
Replaces [gold]Bronze Core[/gold].
The first [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Functions[/gold] you create each combat cost [blue]0[/blue] until played.
